notes.title: Technobabylon - Engine Patch
notes.notes:
Hi,

We're upgrading the game to 3.6 version of AGS, which basically means better rendering, better support for resolutions and better support for keyboard and mice!

The savegames have been tested and should work, and shouldn't break.
If for any reason there's an issue, feel free to report and opt in to beta oldversion, by using the password "oldversionold"
